name: Atelier Amelia

about:
Atelier Amelia is a garment manufacturer based in New York, New York, founded in 2016 by designer Zhu Ru Chen. After struggling to find reliable manufacturers for her own swimwear line, Chen established the company to provide high-quality production with a personal touch for emerging brands.

The company operates a full-service sample room and production factory, offering sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, garment production, and fitting services. Its in-house facility can accommodate 3,000 to 5,000 pieces per month, handling both small production runs and flexible quantities while maintaining quality.

Atelier Amelia serves established and emerging designer labels in the fashion and apparel industry. Clients include brands like Maiden Name, whose co-founder Alix Freireich has worked with the company since 2019. The firm focuses on supporting up-and-coming designers and young creative talent producing in the USA.

The company emphasizes Made-in-NY manufacturing, passion for client success, and future adoption of 3D fitting technology to reduce cost and time. It was started to solve the founder's own difficulty in finding reliable production partners.
